items.name: Application Insights
items.description: Application performance monitoring feature within Azure Monitor that tracks application usage, performance metrics, and diagnoses issues in live applications.

items.name: Dynatrace
items.description: Software intelligence platform that provides application performance monitoring, infrastructure monitoring, and observability using AI-driven analysis of cloud and hybrid environments.

items.name: Jaeger
items.description: Open-source distributed tracing system used to monitor and troubleshoot transactions across microservices-based applications.

items.name: New Relic
items.description: Cloud-based observability platform offering application performance monitoring, infrastructure metrics, and log management for software systems.

items.name: Adobe Analytics
items.description: Web and marketing analytics tool that tracks customer behavior across digital channels to support reporting and audience insights.

items.name: Auvik
items.description: Cloud-based network monitoring and management tool that automatically maps network devices and traffic to give IT teams visibility and alerts.

items.name: Grafana
items.description: Open-source visualization and dashboarding tool used to query, explore, and display metrics and logs from various data sources.

items.name: Prometheus
items.description: Open-source monitoring system and time-series database that collects and queries metrics, commonly used for alerting in cloud-native and Kubernetes environments.

items.name: PRTG Network Monitor
items.description: Network monitoring software that tracks devices, bandwidth, and infrastructure health using various protocols like SNMP and WMI.

items.name: Zabbix
items.description: Open-source monitoring solution for tracking the availability and performance of networks, servers, virtual machines, and applications.

items.name: Azure Log Analytics
items.description: Cloud-based service within Azure Monitor that collects and queries log and telemetry data from Azure and on-premises resources.

items.name: Fluentd
items.description: Open-source data collector that unifies log collection and consumption by parsing, filtering, and routing logs to various backends.

items.name: Logstash
items.description: Server-side data processing pipeline, part of the Elastic Stack, that ingests, transforms, and forwards logs and events to storage or analysis tools.

items.name: Logz.io
items.description: Cloud-based log management and observability platform built on open-source tools like ELK, Prometheus, and Jaeger for centralized monitoring.

items.name: NLog
items.description: Free logging library for .NET applications that supports structured logging and flexible routing of log messages to multiple targets.

items.name: Serilog
items.description: Structured logging library for .NET that captures log events as data and supports many output sinks for storage and analysis.

items.name: Splunk
items.description: Platform for searching, monitoring, and analyzing machine-generated data such as logs, used for operational intelligence and security analytics.
